hook: This is a dense, technical-feeling file about an ancient piece of circuitry and the stone slab it rests on. The first half is procedures and biology, so be patient; the payoff sits in the later addenda and the testimony that closes the page.
whyItMatters: As a very low number it is an early stop for many readers, and the current text carries the rewrite tag, so it reads as a newer treatment of a classic slot. It handles a K-class scenario in an unusual key: the threat is not ruin but a well-meant remaking of the world. Its tags also tie it to Director Moose, who appears here in a pivotal role.
thingsToNotice:
Return to the containment procedures after finishing. The order to keep skin contact during a power loss only makes sense once you learn that living minds slow the growth and also serve as its templates.

The two components form a jailer and prisoner story, with the slab's dwindling power running underneath everything. The removal of O5-10 and the unnamed figure acting in their name hint at politics the file never fully explains. Moose's testimony reframes the danger: a paradise is on offer, but shaped for whichever complex mind reaches it first.

related.note: Named in the file as sharing unexplained biological traits with SCP-003-1.
Also cited as having elements in common with SCP-003-1's biology.
